messages:
Aria: dropped a compact proposal modal iteration and a scrim behavior sketch in Figma: https://figma.com/file/compact-rollback-scrim (frames 'Rollback Proposal Compact', 'Scrim Focus') Tom: quick flag: the compact modal is great for speed, but we mustn't trap focus in a way that hides the rest of the timeline context. propose modal keeps focus in dialog while open, and add a clear 'Close' and 'Esc' affordance. Liu: a11y: scrim must be aria-hidden=true and the dialog should have role=dialog + aria-modal=true + aria-labelledby. also ensure focus returns to the triggering Promote button after close. sample pattern: ```html
...
``` Brenda: microcopy: change header to 'Create rollback proposal' (not 'Rollback') to make it clear it's a proposal that may need approval. confirmation CTA: 'Create proposal' and the destructive action label only appears in the final review. Sam: undo UX: if a quick rollback is allowed, keep a 20s toast undo. but for proposal flow, we should show 'Request undo' as a separate action in the proposal list. Also add an inline note: 'This proposal will not change live traffic until approved.' Aria: visual: compact modal should show version id, commit short, estimated impact (X% traffic change), and a small 'Why' textarea optional. keep keyboard-first layout: stack fields vertically, big targets. Liu: keyboard trap nuance: when the dialog opens, focus the first interactive control. If user tabs past the last control, cycle back to the first. ensure screen readers get a concise description with aria-describedby referencing the impact line. Tom: scrim click behavior: prefer click-to-close for non-destructive flows (proposal), but require explicit confirmation for quick rollback (no scrim-close). so modal type varies: proposal = scrim-close allowed, immediate rollback = modal with no scrim-close and clear destructive warning. note that scrim must not steal focus on open. Brenda: copy for destructive confirm: header 'Revert to vY (destructive)', body 'This will route X% back to vY immediately and cannot be undone via proposals. Confirm to proceed.' CTA 'Confirm revert' + secondary 'Cancel'. For proposals: header 'Create rollback proposal' body 'This will create a proposal for reviewers.' CTA 'Create proposal'. Sam: perf note: keep the compact modal DOM light. lazy-load heavy graphs (metrics, diff) when user expands 'View impact details'. also debounce live health updates while modal open to avoid jarring reorder. Aria: decisions: implement two modal behaviors (proposal=scrim-close allowed, quick-revert=no scrim-close), role/aria-modal patterns, focus management with return-to-trigger, copy updates to 'Create rollback proposal' vs 'Confirm revert', 20s toast undo for quick reverts, lazy-load heavy metrics, and respect reduced-motion. I'll update Figma and ping for a quick a11y pass. deploy-bot: rollback-ui-1767994 recorded by Aria at 2026-03-17T10:12:00Z (design choices logged).
